mapper.sql: p.permission_id as "permissionId", p.role_code as "roleCode", r.role_name as "roleName", p.field_key as "fieldKey", p.raw_view_allowed_yn as "rawViewAllowedYn", p.masked_view_allowed_yn as "maskedViewAllowedYn", p.export_allowed_yn as "exportAllowedYn", p.account_view_allowed_yn as "accountViewAllowedYn", p.change_reason as "changeReason", p.updated_at as "updatedAt", p.updated_by as "updatedBy"
from privacy_access_permissions p left join roles r on r.role_code = p.role_code
mapper.insert: insert into privacy_access_permissions (role_code, field_key, raw_view_allowed_yn, masked_view_allowed_yn, export_allowed_yn, account_view_allowed_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{roleCode}, #{fieldKey}, #{rawViewAllowedYn}, #{maskedViewAllowedYn}, #{exportAllowedYn}, #{accountViewAllowedYn}, #{changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (role_code, field_key) do update set raw_view_allowed_yn = EXCLUDED.raw_view_allowed_yn, masked_view_allowed_yn = EXCLUDED.masked_view_allowed_yn, export_allowed_yn = EXCLUDED.export_allowed_yn, account_view_allowed_yn = EXCLUDED.account_view_allowed_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
